Keep the warm white and cream lit fur, the dark slate face, hands and feet, the ice club, the shapes, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.

chibi-direction-effect-ice-folk-bolas.subject: EFFECT:BOLAS
chibi-direction-effect-ice-folk-bolas.notes: Two ice weights on a cream cord: the thrown bolas.

chibi-direction-effect-ice-folk-cold-sna.subject: EFFECT:COLD_SNAP
chibi-direction-effect-ice-folk-cold-sna.notes: A ring of ice crystal points with an empty middle: scaled out to two tiles from the Witch.

chibi-direction-effect-ice-folk-frost-hi.subject: EFFECT:FROST_HIT
chibi-direction-effect-ice-folk-frost-hi.notes: Frost forming: a little star of ice spikes, for a unit as it is chilled.

chibi-direction-effect-ice-folk-shatter.subject: EFFECT:SHATTER
chibi-direction-effect-ice-folk-shatter.notes: The Shatter burst: sharp ice shards flying out from a white flash, mapped to the frost palette.

chibi-direction-effect-ice-folk-shatter-.subject: EFFECT:SHATTER_SHARDS
chibi-direction-effect-ice-folk-shatter-.notes: Loose ice shards in a ring with space between them: the second stage of the Shatter, flying out and melting.

chibi-direction-ice-folk-boulder-yeti.subject: UNIT:ICE_FOLK:CATAPULT
chibi-direction-ice-folk-boulder-yeti.notes: A big yeti of the faction's fur lifting an icy boulder over its head: told from the Yeti by its bigger canvas, raised arms and the blue boulder.

chibi-direction-ice-folk-city-1.subject: CITY:ICE_FOLK:1
chibi-direction-ice-folk-city-1.notes: City 1: a snow-block igloo, a hide cone tent, two ice blocks and a tall bone pole for the pennant, with no ground under it.

chibi-direction-ice-folk-city-2.subject: CITY:ICE_FOLK:2
chibi-direction-ice-folk-city-2.notes: City 2: two igloos and a long ice hall with a cream hide roof inside a snow-block wall, a bone pole for the pennant, no ground.

chibi-direction-ice-folk-city-3.subject: CITY:ICE_FOLK:3
chibi-direction-ice-folk-city-3.notes: City 3: a domed great hall with two ice towers in a ring of igloos, a tall bone pole for the pennant, no ground.

chibi-direction-ice-folk-frost-giant.subject: UNIT:ICE_FOLK:JUGGERNAUT
chibi-direction-ice-folk-frost-giant.notes: A towering giant of slate stone in ice armour with an ice axe and a frosty white beard: the reward unit, far bigger than the Mammoth.

chibi-direction-ice-folk-ice-witch.subject: UNIT:ICE_FOLK:CAPTAIN
chibi-direction-ice-folk-ice-witch.notes: Pale skin, snow-white hair, a tall ice crown, a navy robe with white fur and frost, a staff topped by an ice crystal: findable at a glance by the crown, which the accent step turns deep ice blue.

chibi-direction-ice-folk-mammoth.subject: UNIT:ICE_FOLK:GUARD
chibi-direction-ice-folk-mammoth.notes: A woolly mammoth in side view: warm cream-to-tan wool, a dark slate face and trunk, long ivory tusks with frost on the tips. Fills the GUARD canvas width.

chibi-direction-ice-folk-musk-ox.subject: UNIT:ICE_FOLK:SWORDSMAN
chibi-direction-ice-folk-musk-ox.notes: Bead pulp_wars-2yc.34: accepted Musk Ox. A low wide body under a skirt of dark brown wool with a paler mane and a rust-brown saddle patch, a slate muzzle held low and two thick horns curling down beside the cheeks, coated in ice-blue frost; 54 x 53 px, lower than the Mammoth (53 x 61) and as low as the Yeti. Reviewed at 1:1 and x4 on Grass, Snow and Mountain beside the Yeti, the Mammoth and the Sabretooth.

chibi-direction-ice-folk-sabretooth.subject: UNIT:ICE_FOLK:KNIGHT
chibi-direction-ice-folk-sabretooth.notes: The pale snow-leopard Sabretooth with ice-blue eyes and small ice crystals of frost along its back: the faction's accent on it too.

chibi-direction-ice-folk-sled.subject: UNIT:ICE_FOLK:RAIDER
chibi-direction-ice-folk-sled.notes: Two grey-and-white huskies pulling an ivory bone sled with a fur-clad driver whirling a bolas with two ice weights: low, fast, and plainly the one that throws the frost.

chibi-direction-ice-folk-snow-hunter.subject: UNIT:ICE_FOLK:MARKSMAN
chibi-direction-ice-folk-snow-hunter.notes: The Snow Hunter with tan skin and a dark charcoal fringe: nothing in the owner key band.

chibi-direction-ice-folk-yeti.subject: UNIT:ICE_FOLK:FIGHTER
chibi-direction-ice-folk-yeti.notes: The study's chosen fur (F2): warm white and cream fur shaded warm taupe, a dark slate face, hands and feet, and the ice club in the deep ice blue of the accent step. Broad and upright, clearly an ape.

chibi-direction-icon-action-cold-snap.subject: ICON:ACTION:COLD_SNAP
chibi-direction-icon-action-cold-snap.notes: Cold Snap: a big ice snowflake with a ring of shards, alone on transparency.

chibi-direction-icon-action-freeze.subject: ICON:ACTION:FREEZE
chibi-direction-icon-action-freeze.notes: Freeze: a curling sea wave frozen solid, icicles on its crest. Candidate 0 keeps more icicles than candidate 1.

chibi-direction-icon-action-prowl.subject: ICON:ACTION:PROWL
chibi-direction-icon-action-prowl.notes: Prowl: a trail of big cat paw prints with dark slate pads.

chibi-direction-icon-action-rockfall.subject: ICON:ACTION:ROCKFALL
chibi-direction-icon-action-rockfall.notes: Rockfall: an icy rock flying off a small snowy peak.

chibi-direction-icon-action-shatter.subject: ICON:ACTION:SHATTER
chibi-direction-icon-action-shatter.notes: Shatter: an ice block bursting into shards round a white flash.

chibi-direction-icon-action-sweep.subject: ICON:ACTION:SWEEP
chibi-direction-icon-action-sweep.notes: Sweep: a mammoth's tusk swinging with a wide white swoosh.

chibi-direction-icon-action-throw-bolas.subject: ICON:ACTION:THROW_BOLAS
chibi-direction-icon-action-throw-bolas.notes: Bolas: two ice weights joined by a cream cord, alone. Weak: at 24 px it can read as a pair of cherries.

chibi-direction-icon-status-chilled.subject: ICON:STATUS:CHILLED
chibi-direction-icon-status-chilled.notes: Chilled, the Frosted glyph: one symmetrical ice snowflake.

chibi-direction-icon-status-frozen.subject: ICON:STATUS:FROZEN
chibi-direction-icon-status-frozen.notes: Frozen: a cube of clear ice with icicles, for the sluggish status line.

chibi-direction-icon-tech-black-ice.subject: ICON:TECH:ICE_FOLK:SEAMANSHIP
chibi-direction-icon-tech-black-ice.notes: Black Ice: a round slab of glossy near-black ice with a white shine, ringed by bright ice spikes. Candidate 0 has the bolder shine.

chibi-direction-icon-tech-brittle.subject: ICON:TECH:ICE_FOLK:EXPLOSIVES
chibi-direction-icon-tech-brittle.notes: Brittle: a cube of ice split by dark zigzag cracks.

chibi-direction-icon-tech-deep-winter.subject: ICON:TECH:ICE_FOLK:FORTIFICATION
chibi-direction-icon-tech-deep-winter.notes: Deep Winter: an igloo with a snowdrift spreading from it and snowflakes falling.

chibi-direction-icon-tech-glacier.subject: ICON:TECH:ICE_FOLK:SUBMERSIBLES
chibi-direction-icon-tech-glacier.notes: Glacier: a tall wall of blue ice under a snow cap with a cave at its foot (the shelter). It fills the canvas with no margin; the whole wall is inside it.

chibi-direction-icon-tech-icebound.subject: ICON:TECH:ICE_FOLK:NAVAL_ENGINEERING
chibi-direction-icon-tech-icebound.notes: Icebound: a small timber hull tilted and gripped by jagged spikes of ice.

chibi-direction-icon-tech-pack-ice.subject: ICON:TECH:ICE_FOLK:NAVIGATION
chibi-direction-icon-tech-pack-ice.notes: Pack Ice: a pointed iceberg with a snow cap and a floe at its foot.

chibi-direction-icon-tech-rime.subject: ICON:TECH:ICE_FOLK:SHORECRAFT
chibi-direction-icon-tech-rime.notes: Rime: a fur-topped hide boot on a blade of ice, the slide across the frozen shallows. Candidate 0; candidate 1 is the same with a duller toe.

chibi-direction-portrait-ice-folk-boulde.subject: PORTRAIT:ICE_FOLK:CATAPULT
chibi-direction-portrait-ice-folk-boulde.notes: Boulder Yeti portrait with ice crystals crusted on the boulder, as on the map sprite.

chibi-direction-portrait-ice-folk-frost-.subject: PORTRAIT:ICE_FOLK:JUGGERNAUT
chibi-direction-portrait-ice-folk-frost-.notes: Frost Giant portrait: a slate stone giant with an ice beard and ice crystal shoulders. Weak: the beard is ice blue here and white on the map.

chibi-direction-portrait-ice-folk-ice-wi.subject: PORTRAIT:ICE_FOLK:CAPTAIN
chibi-direction-portrait-ice-folk-ice-wi.notes: Ice Witch portrait: pale face, long white hair and the tall ice crown, a navy robe with white fur.

chibi-direction-portrait-ice-folk-mammot.subject: PORTRAIT:ICE_FOLK:GUARD
chibi-direction-portrait-ice-folk-mammot.notes: Mammoth portrait: a whole small mammoth with cream wool, a charcoal face and trunk and frosted tusks. Weak: a whole figure, not a bust.

chibi-direction-portrait-ice-folk-musk-o.subject: PORTRAIT:ICE_FOLK:SWORDSMAN
chibi-direction-portrait-ice-folk-musk-o.notes: Bead pulp_wars-2yc.34: accepted Musk Ox portrait. A big shaggy dark brown head and shoulders with a paler mane, a slate muzzle and two thick horns curling beside the cheeks in ice-blue frost, matching the map sprite. Reviewed at 1:1 and x8 beside the Mammoth's portrait.

chibi-direction-portrait-ice-folk-sabret.subject: PORTRAIT:ICE_FOLK:KNIGHT
chibi-direction-portrait-ice-folk-sabret.notes: Sabretooth portrait with a dark charcoal mouth instead of red.

chibi-direction-portrait-ice-folk-sled.subject: PORTRAIT:ICE_FOLK:RAIDER
chibi-direction-portrait-ice-folk-sled.notes: The Sled driver's portrait with nothing red. Weak: the recoloured mouth reads as a dark smudge.

chibi-direction-portrait-ice-folk-snow-h.subject: PORTRAIT:ICE_FOLK:MARKSMAN
chibi-direction-portrait-ice-folk-snow-h.notes: Snow Hunter portrait: the face in a cream fur hood, the ice-tipped harpoon on the shoulder.

chibi-direction-portrait-ice-folk-yeti.subject: PORTRAIT:ICE_FOLK:FIGHTER
chibi-direction-portrait-ice-folk-yeti.notes: Yeti portrait: a close-up round furry head with a dark charcoal face, fangs and the icy club beside it.
